verdict.rationale: A state business-filing system like the SCC's Clerk's Information System could plausibly offer bulk filings or bulk data operations, so this question applies to the product. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes, and none of them document any bulk-operation capability. Crawling restrictions say nothing about whether bulk actions exist, so the verdict is none rather than na.
